@Bettina Kroll: The only source I can see is Moss's Coastal digest dated Sun 11/2/2025. It says Pellucid Harbor Logistics "changes hands tomorrow, 2025-11-03." That is the planned handoff date. I found no later note confirming the transfer actually completed, so for the tracker I'd record 2025-11-03 as the scheduled date and check with Moss or Kwame before marking it as the official change date.

Also, "PHL" is shorthand for two accounts in these notes (Pellucid Harbor Logistics and Covey & Lark Retail, now Pellow Home Living). Make sure you're looking at the Pellucid Harbor entry.
